sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

# Let's examine the transition that led to game_over. Find first game_over.
for i,t in enumerate(transitions):
    if t.result.get('game_over'):
        print('first game over at index', i, 'action', t.action, 'before step', t.before_frame.step)
        # print before/after pink
        def get_pink_hashes(frame):
            nodes=frame.segmentation['nodes']
            id_to_node={n['id']:n for n in nodes}
            pink_bar=next((n for n in nodes if n['color']=='P' and any(p[0]>=51 and p[0]<=55 for p in n['boundary'])), None)
            return [id_to_node[c]['hash'] for c in pink_bar['children']] if pink_bar else []
        print('before pink', get_pink_hashes(t.before_frame))
        print('after pink', get_pink_hashes(t.after_frame))
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
